changes: Added a local decision-doc quorum evaluator, DONE gate integration, CLI diagnostic, process fact registry coverage, command ownership semantics, focused smoke tests, and lifecycle docs for 3-round 2-host host_verdict verification.
usage: Run node packages/main/dist/cli.js decision_doc_quorum_check --storyId=<storyId> to inspect quorum, then use normal lattice story_advance --phase=DONE; DONE blocks changed decision docs without fresh 3x2 host_verdict quorum.
expectedOutcome: For direct docs/requirements/decisions/*.md changes, DONE requires three distinct review rounds with at least two distinct PASSing hosts per round bound to the current material digest.
actualTranscript: decision_doc_quorum_check reports pass for B-2c0c with materialDigest 2cdbd05456e9596f0f7b20fe740fe2e6d945f26ffa944abcffd456817e23b82c and three fresh rounds; lattice validate reports allPass true and 12/12 verification intents covered; evidence_inspect reports fresh staleRefs 0.
outcomeDiff: No product-level diff: actual output matches expected quorum behavior and rejects stale/prose-only evidence as non-quorum.
limitations: The source and built local CLI are verified; global lattice exposure depends on the normal main merge/build synchronization after DONE.
pitfalls: Two old duplicate build evidence entries stayed stale even after fresh evidence was added; fixed by returning to DEV and replacing the evidence arrays through checklist_update instead of editing story JSON.
